Industrial fasteners, delivered

Meridian Supply Co. has served manufacturers across the Midwest since 1974. Our catalog spans over 40,000 SKUs of bolts, screws, anchors, and specialty fasteners, stocked across three regional distribution centers in Ohio, Indiana, and Michigan.

We work with procurement teams at mid-size manufacturers who need reliable next-day fulfillment and consistent quality documentation. Every shipment includes full material certification, and our team of 28 handles both standing orders and rush requests.

Our warehouse in Toledo operates six days a week, and we maintain direct relationships with domestic mills so that lead times stay predictable even when supply chains tighten. Customers routinely tell us the difference is that someone actually answers the phone.

Call us at +1 419 555 0142 or email sales@meridiansupply.com to set up an account. Volume pricing is available for annual contracts.
